head: Microsoft MAI models: seven new AI models, some in GitHub Copilot
dek: Microsoft announced seven of its own AI models, called MAI, at its Ignite event on 17 November, for coding, image editing, real-time voice, transcription and security. Microsoft says they cost a fraction of rival models from OpenAI and others.
details: MAI Code 2 is live in GitHub Copilot's paid plans, and MAI Code 2 Flash also in its Free and Student plans. MAI Image 2.7 and a cheaper Flash version are in public preview on Microsoft Foundry and partner services such as Genspark, OpenRouter and Vercel. MAI Realtime 1, a voice model, is open for sign-up through MAI Labs. The comparisons with other models are Microsoft's own numbers. The reports don't mention the Copilot app for everyday users.
where: GitHub Copilot and Microsoft's developer services now; nothing announced for the Copilot app
means: For most people nothing changes today: these models go to developers and companies first. If you use GitHub Copilot, even on the free plan, you can now pick one of Microsoft's own coding models.
todo: Nothing to do in the Copilot app. If you code with GitHub Copilot, look for MAI Code 2 Flash in its model picker.
